## Synopsis

Wires the hooks and the MCP entry into each named harness: claude-code, codex or
gemini. Without --managed it writes your own settings, and with --managed the
root-owned layout that a user cannot edit.

```
straza install <harness>... [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  straza install claude-code
  sudo straza install --managed --server https://straza.example.com claude-code
```

## Options

```
      --bin-dir string   managed binary directory (default: /usr/local/bin or %ProgramData%\straza\bin)
      --managed          install the root-owned, managed layout that a user cannot edit (run with sudo, or as an administrator on Windows)
      --server string    strazad base URL the managed layout pins for every user of this machine (required with --managed)
```
